description: Read real candles from the Taifoon tape for one market. Use it to ground an answer in what the market actually did in a past window — never to predict. NQ is not continuous (weekend halt, 21:00 UTC daily break). A past window is SEALED: its bars never change, so cache it. The same tape is open over plain HTTP with no key: GET https://clob.taifoon.dev/tape/v1/candles/{market}/{tf}?from=&to= with unix SECONDS and a User-Agent that names you (OpenAPI: https://www.taifoon.io/clob/openapi.yaml). It is the tape the coordination layer's conformance check replays, so what you read here is what the judge reads.

tf.description: timeframe (the time machine serves these; build a 15-minute range from 1m or 5m bars)

to.description: window end, ISO-8601 UTC, in the past

name: tape
